color.note: Warm paper and Sage green. Amber appears once per screen, on the single most important highlight.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground — warm paper in light, deep ink in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chat windows, dashboard panels, inputs.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on background or surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata on background or surface (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines on cards, inputs and dividers — used instead of shadows.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Sage. Primary buttons, links, active states, the logo mark. As text, legible on background and surface.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Derived tint: Sage message bubbles, selected chips, the radial glow's core. Text on it is text or primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Insight amber. Only the single most important highlight on a screen. Fill only — never as text on paper; text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Derived tint behind an amber highlight (a paste event, an alert row). Text on it is text.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Positive state — seat OK, low Reliance Score. Fill or icon; as small text use primary instead.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look. Fill or icon only; fails as text on paper.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors in forms and destructive states. 3:1 as icon; pair with a text label.

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: Instrument Serif, large headlines only. Regular weight; italics for one emphasised word at most.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Panel headings, stat numbers on marketing pages.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist for all interface and body text.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A tutor that builds real understanding.
styles.usage: Hero subheadline and section intros. 18px / 28px on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hints, questions and explanations grounded in course notes.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.sample: Built at IIT Mandi · Now piloting

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Geist Mono for code and numbers in product UI.

spacing.note: 8px grid. 12 columns, 1200px max content width, 120–160px between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between chat messages, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (minimum).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (generous).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

radius.note: Soft and bookish: 16px cards, 12px controls, pills for status.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Citation chips, small badges, seat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, chat windows, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The final call-to-action panel, large product frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, toggles.

shadow.note: Borders first. One soft lift, only on hover; one focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Cards on hover (with a 2–4px rise), floating callouts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element.
